notes.title: Devlog #6 - Summary of May development process
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, The Pope: Power & Sin community![/h2]

It's time for a Summary of the May development process. It was a very busy month, we focused on character development, in terms of graphics models, personality, and story.

Summary of Pope's May developement:
- 10 new story characters in 3D
- Full voiceover for main story character conversations for Prologue and Chapter I.
- System for buying and unlocking artifacts with collected influence (in-game currency)
- Updated screens and menu functions in the game

[img]https://i.ibb.co/h94q9WS/rodrigo.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/W0m9BSd/cesare.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/d5bFdK6/gulia.gif[/img]

[h2]Stay tuned for the next updates![/h2]
